task: Evaluate LLM performance on multi-step Hartree-Fock calculations for AB-stacked MoTe2/WSe2
method: Structured prompt template extraction and scoring of HF calculation steps

evaluation_framework.extraction: LLM extracts placeholder values from paper text using structured templates
evaluation_framework.scoring: Three human graders (Haining, Will, Yasaman) score on 0-2 scale
evaluation_framework.task_scoring: Six categories: in_paper, prompt_quality, follow_instructions, physics_logic, math_derivation, final_answer_accuracy
